title: PublicProseArtifact
description: Final reader-facing prose. Must be generated from prior artifacts, not directly from source material. Requires at least one extraction artifact and one validation artifact in input_artifact_ids before status can be reviewed or published. Stage G of the artifact pipeline.

input_artifact_ids.description: Must include at least one raw_extraction and one validation artifact to reach reviewed/published status

summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary for aggregators or search results

emergency_prototype_mode.description: If true, this prose was generated directly from source material without prior artifacts. Explicitly mark only.

editorial_status.description: reviewed/published require input_artifact_ids to include raw_extraction and validation
